long_biography.plain_text:
Investor Gérard López treated Formula One as a meeting place for businesses as well as a racing competition. At Lotus, he used Genii Business Exchange to connect companies through the team's international exposure. He initially visited the team weekly to check progress against its targets, subsequently reducing his routine involvement.

His own driving developed through historic endurance racing. With Marcel Fässler, he won two separate race groups at the Daytona Classic in 2023, driving both a Lola T70 and a Cadillac prototype. The pair later shared the Vintage Prototype/Sports Racer championship, tying with Travis Engen in the final standings.
